info.title: lean2il: compile Lean 4 definitions to a .NET assembly, after re-checking every proof with Tenet.
info.description: Compile Lean 4 definitions to a .NET assembly, after re-checking every proof about them with Tenet.

options.name: --out
options.description: where to write the assembly and its docs (default: <lake-project>/.lake/dotnet)

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Lean namespace the exports live in, and the .NET namespace (default: inferred)

options.name: --class
options.description: static class holding the exported functions (default: Proven)

options.name: --trust-imports
options.description: re-check only the project's own modules, not Lean's library under them

options.name: --no-check
options.description: skip the Tenet re-check (the docs then say the proofs were not re-checked)

options.name: --fuzz
options.description:
random inputs per exported function, run by Lean and by the IL, which must
agree (default 100; 0 skips it)

options.name: --leanviz
options.description: LeanViz site for the project; theorem names in the docs link there

options.name: --source
options.description: base URL of the Lean sources, for links to each theorem's line

options.name: --lake-build
options.description: run `lake build` in the project first

options.name: --msbuild
options.description: report errors as file(line,col): error CODE: text, for MSBuild and IDEs
